notes.title: Trials of Fire 1.05 Update now Live
notes.content:
[b]Trials of Fire 1.05 Release Notes[/b]


Happy weekend,

This week’s update focuses on bugs and some balance changes. In addition to this patch, this week saw the release of Steam trading cards, badges and profile backgrounds. We hope you are enjoying these.

As always, please let us know what you think of the changes on Discord.

Thanks!



[b]Card Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] ‘Pommel Strike’ (Warrior) – Decreased Melee Damage to 1 (from 2).
[*] ‘Shield Master’ (Warrior) – Reduced cost to 0 (from 1).
[*] ‘Overwatch’ (Hunter) – Reduced damage to 3 (from 4).
[*] ‘Shadow’ (Assassin) – Increased Resilience to 6 (from 4).
[*] ‘Channel Spirit’ (Spirit Speaker) – Increased Resilience to 6 (from 4).
[*] ‘Earthfire’ (Spirit Spear) – Increased damage multiplier to 3 (from 2).
[*] ‘Study’ – Increased cost to 1.
[/list]

[b]Boss Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased health on all Tier 4 + 5 bosses to tweak their difficulty a little bit.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a strange issue when re-shuffling cards that could sometimes cause them to go into the wrong deck.
[*] Fixed graphics settings being reset to default when creating a new profile.
[*] Fixed the cursor disappearing when exiting an adventure after using a gamepad and switching back to mouse.
[*] Fixed gamepad not interacting with the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Trials of Fire v1.04 now Live
notes.content:
[b]Trials of Fire 1.04 Release Notes[/b]


Happy weekend,

This week’s update includes gamepad (controller) support for playing the game. We’d appreciate feedback from players on this feature before we go about integrating it into the game’s tutorials so please let us know what you think!

Also some balance changes looking to level out some outlying Heroes and Bosses.

Thanks!



[b]Gamepad Support[/b]

The game can now be played using gamepad. Please give us feedback so we can finalise and then integrate this fully into tutorials etc.

[list]
[*] Common
[list]
[*] (A) – Select
[*] (B) – Back/Undo
[*] (LT) – Tool Tips
[*] (Left Stick) – Free Cursor
[*] (DPad) – Snap Cursor
[/list]

[*] Adventure
[list]
[*] (X) – Equip/Unequip
[*] (Y) – Make Camp
[*] (LB) – Cycle Hero Inventory
[*] (Right Stick) – Scroll box
[/list]

[*] Combat
[list]
[*] (X) – Recycle
[*] (Y) – End Turn
[*] (LB) – Cycle Hero hands
[*] (RT) – Fast Forward
[/list]

[*] [b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Options menu still requires use of the mouse.
[*] Not integrated fully into Combat Tutorial.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Hero Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduces Spirit Speaker ‘Empower’ talent Defence bonus to +1.
[list]
[*] Spirit Speaker is the most successful hero class right now – with a lot of decks relying on ‘Force Field’ for big team-wide defence. We’ll monitor the effect of this change on his playstyle.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Boss Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the deck of the Charred Sun Priest a bit to increase difficulty.
[*] Lowered Willpower on the Lurker.
[/list]

[b]Cataclysm Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Cataclysm 8 effect to, 'Bosses draw extra cards equal to half their Tier (rounded down),' in order to give a more even challenge.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare issue where a quest objective could appear in an unreachable location.
[/list]

notes.title: Trials of Fire 1.03 Update now Live
notes.content:
Trials of Fire 1.03 Release Notes


Happy Friday,

This update focuses on some Tutorial updates for new players and some new modifiers to allow players to enjoy the game differently.

We’ve also toned down the late game bosses slightly on Medium. Now that they all seem to be sitting at a more even level, we’re toning them all down slightly.

Thanks!


[b]Feature Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom portraits will now be remembered for each class until you change it.
[/list]

[b]Tutorial Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Redrawing tutorial to the basic Combat Tutorial.
[*] Added a tutorial for Underway (cavern) entrances.
[/list]

[b]Modifiers[/b]
Added the following optional game modifiers.
[list]
[*] Added ‘Three Lives’ modifier.
[list]
[*] You will be able to restart battles up to 3 times in a run after being defeated.
[/list]
[*] Added ‘Flesh Wound’ modifier.
[list]
[*] Being defeated in a non-main path battle will not result in a game over.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Boss Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the difficulty of Tier 3+ bosses slightly on Medium.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed another issue with the Giant Worm head getting on top of its body.
[*] Fixed the Dread Fly not being able to move or attack over obstacles.
[*] Fixed being able to hone an item more than once.
[*] Fixed ‘Juba’s Skull’ and ‘Rinn’s Manual’ legendaries not working properly together.
[*] Stability fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Trials of Fire 1.02 Update now Live
notes.content:
Trials of Fire 1.02 Release Notes


Hello all,

What a week! It’s been a super exciting time for us since the 1.0 launch last Friday. We’ve been gathering tons of feedback and data from all our new players that will really help us make the game even better going forward.

This week’s update addresses some of the bugs that have been appearing and some small tweaks to the game’s bosses to make the challenge a bit more consistent at each boss tier.

For the next week or two we will be focusing on:
[list]
[*] Updated tutorials to help teach new players some of the mechanics that can still be unclear.
[*] A handful of new modifiers to allow you to play differently. 
[*] More balance changes based on new player feedback and data.
[/list]

During this time. we will also publish a plan for content going forward.

Thanks!



[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed player getting stuck in the Combat Run quest if you leave the game while camping.
[*] Fixed the Hybrid Berserker advancing onto the same space as their allies.
[*] Fixed the Giant Worm head from sometimes appearing on top of its body after being pushed/pulled.
[*] Tons of typos!
[/list]

[b]Boss Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the Willpower of the Green Dragon.
[*] Reduced the Willpower of the Red Dragon.
[*] Reduced the Willpower of Lurker.
[/list]

notes.title: Trials of Fire Exiting Early Access
notes.content:
[h1]Trials of Fire 1.0 Release[/h1]


Hi everyone,

This update sees Trials of Fire transitioning out of Early Access and into full release. It’s been an exciting ride to get here with our debut game and we’re glad that so many of you are playing and enjoying Trials of Fire already.

Along with the latest update, we also have a digital Artbook and Map as well as the game’s official Soundtrack available from Steam. If you prefer you can get all 3 in the collector’s Inferno Bundle.

As always, we want to express our thanks for the awesome support of our Early Access community who were so instrumental in getting us to this point - both with your support and feedback. It's no understatement to say we wouldn't be here without you!

Also note that along with the 1.0 release, we are resetting the game's leaderboards to give everyone a fighting chance with all the changes since the last leaderboard reset.


Thanks!
Whatboy Games



Trials of Fire 1.005 Release Notes

This update marks us moving out of Early Access and into full release.

Update highlights include a brand new playable Hero, a rework to the Assassin’s Stealth mechanic and a host of updates to item based cards.


[b]New Hero – The Occultist[/b]
[list]
[*] Communes with otherworldly powers to deal damage or buff your party. Beware though, such power always comes with a price.
[*] Ranged damage dealer or support character.
[*] Many of their abilities will do damage or place negative named effects on themself, but others will grow stronger as they take damage or get more afflicted.
[*] Has the unique ability to remove cards from the battle to thin your deck on the fly or remove weaknesses.
[/list]

[b]Instant Cards[/b]
[list]
[*] Many created cards have now been re-branded as ‘Instant’.
[*] These function largely the same, as before, but are now removed from the game automatically when ending your turn (and do not count towards your 1 held card limit).
[*] Instant is a new keyword with the following effects:
[list]
[*] May not be Recycled or Redrawn.
[*] Automatically removed from the battle at the end of your turn.
[/list]
[*] This keyword replaces the text on many cards.
[/list]

[b]Stealth Rework[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve reworked the Stealth named effect to better suit the Assassin’s playstyle.
[*] Stealth now has no immediate effect and ticks down like any other named effect.
[*] If you can maintain stealth until the start of your turn, it triggers some powerful new abilities.
[*] Stealth effect:
[list]
[*] Cannot be targeted by enemies unless they are adjacent.
[*] Every time you are hit, lose 1 stack of Stealth.
[*] At the start of your turn, gain +2 to Melee and Ranged damage for the turn and add a Move Unseen card to your hand.
[/list]
[*] Move Unseen token card – ‘Move 1 + your Stealth stacks, ignoring enemies.’
[/list]

[b]Hero Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The Spirit Speaker now has a Heavy Armour slot instead of Light Armour to allow for a bit of extra tankiness.
[*] The Assassin no longer has access to Heavy Armour to slightly reduce their tankiness.
[/list]

[b]Language Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Russian localisation now fully implemented.
[/list]

[b]Profile Management[/b]
[list]
[*] You may now have up to 4 separate save profiles on your machine to allow other household members to play on one machine.
[/list]

[b]Item Card Review[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve updated a lot of the weaker item cards to make sure more items are viable in high-level builds.
[*] Most of these buffs come in the form of powerful, conditional effects to boost the cards based on how you play them. This 
[/list]

[b]Card Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] ‘Fly’ – Changed effect to, ‘Move to any free space. Any Magic Damage cards in hand gain +1 to damage.’
[*] ‘Quick Shot’ – Changed effect to, ‘Ranged Attack 1, then draw a card. Deal +2 damage if your previous card played was a Move card.’ 
[*] ‘Quick Thinking’ – Changed basic effect to, ‘Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and choose one to draw. Refresh your Talent.’ 
[*] ‘Chaos Missiles’ – Changed effect to, ‘Deal 3 Magic Damage to all enemies within 3 spaces. Deal +2 damage if you have 5+ Defence. 
[*] ‘Wing Smash’ – Now deals Magic Damage. 
[*] ‘Reel In’ – Changed effect to, ‘Ranged Attack 1 then Pull the target 3 Spaces. Afterwards, if the target is adjacent to you, draw a card.’ 
[*] ‘Lunge’ – Changed effect to, ‘Move 1 to Target, Melee Attack 3. Every time you play a card, increase movement by 1.’ 
[*] ‘Strike Through’ – Changed effect to, ‘Melee Attack 3 or Ranged Attack 2. Also hits anyone directly behind the target. If you hit 2 targets, gain 1 Willpower.’ 
[*] ‘Sleep Dart’ – Changed effect to, ‘Ranged Attack 2. For every 2 damage dealt, shuffle a temporary Fatigue card into target's deck.’ 
[*] ‘Dark Rite’ – Changed effect to, ‘Melee Attack 2. If you deal damage, take 1 raw damage and gain +1 to Magic Damage for the rest of the battle.’ 
[*] ‘Reach’ – Increased cost to 1 (from 0).
[*] ‘Armoured Advance’ – Changed effect to, ‘Move 2, Defend 3 and gain 1 Willpower. Shuffle an Exhausted card into your deck.’ 
[*] ‘Wide Sweep’ - Changed effect to, ‘Melee Attack 5 on all adjacent enemies. If you hit 2 or more targets, draw a Defend card from your deck or discard pile.’ 
[*] ‘Fearsome Shout’ – Changed effect to, ‘All enemies within Range 2 are inflicted with Exposed and discard a card. Gain 1 Willpower for every WEAKNESS card in hand.’ 
[*] ‘Rage’ – Changed effect to, ‘Draw 2 cards. Gain 1 Willpower for every WEAKNESS card in hand. Shuffle a Fatigue into your deck.’ 
[*] ‘Detonate’ – Reduced cost to 1 and changed effect to, ‘Destroy a friendly Summoned character and deal Magic Damage to all adjacent characters equal to the health of the destroyed unit. 
[*] ’Piercing Arrow’ – Changed effect to, ‘Unblockable Ranged Attack 3. If you spent 0 Willpower for this card, remove Defence equal to the damage dealt.’ 
[*] ‘Phosphor Arrow’ – Changed effect to, ‘Ranged Attack 5. If the target is Burning, deal 3 Magic Damage to all enemies within 2 spaces.’ 
[*] ‘Coordinate’ – Changed effect to, ‘Target other friendly Hero draws 1 card. If the target has any named effects, Activate yourself.’ 
[*] ‘Improvise’ – Changed effect to, ‘Target friendly Hero upgrades a card in hand and reduces its cost by 1.’ 
[*] ‘Last Stand’ – Increased defence bonus to 2 for each point of health below 10 (from 1). 
[*] ‘Aimed Shot’ – Changed effect to, ‘Ranged Attack 8. This card cannot be played. Cancel this effect at the end of your turn or when you play a Power on yourself.’ 
[*] ‘Grit’ – Changed effect to, ‘Gain Protected 2 then Defend 2.’
[*] ‘Think Ahead’ – Reduced cost to 0 and changed effect to, ‘Shuffle 2 cards from Shiv, Simple Shot and Guard into your deck. The next time you draw cards this turn, draw 1 extra card.’ 
[*] ‘Insult’ (Warlord) – Changed effect to, ‘Inflict Defenceless 2 to an enemy character or grant Inspired 2 to a friendly character. Inflict +1 stack for every WEAKNESS card in hand.’ 
[*] ‘Intimidate’ (Warrior) – Changed effect to, ‘Inflict Weakened 2 on all enemies within 2 spaces. Inflict +1 stack for every WEAKNESS card in hand.’ 
[*] ‘Unstable Flask’ (Alchemist) – Changed upgraded effect to, ‘Choose 1 from 3 random BASIC cards to create in your hand and reduce its Willpower cost by 1. Then do this a second time.’ 
[*] ‘Elixir of Power’ (Alchemist) – Increased card options to 4 (from 2).
[*] ‘Run+’ – Changed effect to, ‘Move 4 and gain 1 Willpower. Activate.’
[*] ‘Momentum’ (Warrior) – Changed effect to, ‘Defend 2. If your last card played was a Melee Attack card, draw a card.’
[*] ‘Stalk’ – Increased Resilience to 3 (from 1).
[*] ‘Battle Ready’ – Increased cost to 4 (from 3).
[*] ‘Teamwork’ – Increased cost to 1 (from 0).
[*] ‘Sneak’ (Assassin) – Now grants Stealth 2 (up from 1).
[*] ‘Hidden Shot’ (Assassin) – Now grants Stealth 2 (up from 1).
[*] ‘Smoke Bomb’ (Assassin) – Now grants Stealth 2 (up from 1) and increased cost to 2 (from 1).
[*] ‘Shadow Strike’ (Assassin) – Changed effect to, ‘Ranged Attack 2 then move to the closest free space adjacent to the target. If you have Stealth, gain 1 Willpower.’
[*] ‘Opening’ (Assassin) – Reduced damage to 2 (from 3).
[*] ‘Low Profile’ (Assassin) – Increased cost to 1 (from 0).
[/list]

[b]Boss Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the Willpower of the Red Dragon.
[*] Reduced the Willpower of the Planar.
[*] Reworked Blue Dragon deck a bit to increase challenge slightly.
[/list]

[b]Endless Odyssey[/b]
[list]
[*] Standard (non) boss encounters will now ‘level up’ with every 5 objectives completed.
[*] Enemies’ health will increase by 100% and they will draw 1 extra card each turn.
[*] Enemy numbers will be reduced by 50%.
[*] This is to stop the difficulty of these encounters being limited by the 9 unit maximum and to introduce more variety for those players fighting on in this mode.
[*] Random (non-objective) boss encounters will also now increase in difficulty the further in you go.
[/list]

[b]Cataclysm Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Cataclysm 6 effect is now, ‘Bosses gain an additional 15% health and Power resilience bonus per Tier.’ Top Tier bosses now have a 200% bonus to Power resilience.
[/list]

notes.content:
[b]Trials of Fire v0.89 Release Notes[/b]

Happy Monday everyone.

This week’s update is not going to be too exciting for our existing players I’m afraid. We’ve updated the game tutorials and tool-tips to help new players into the game more smoothly.

This update will also be the last Weekly Update before our 1.0 launch soon. (Look out for an announcement tomorrow!) It’s been a hell of a ride up to this point and we are so grateful to everyone who has tried out our Early Access build and given us feedback on Steam and Discord. The game is so much better because of all of you!

Let us know what you think of any of these changes on Discord and I’ll see you on the other side!

[b]Tutorial Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated combat and adventure tutorials to better explain game mechanics (and point players to where they can find answers in-game).
[/list]

[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated card and effect tool-tips to be more consistent, clearer and give a bit more detail about how game effects work.
[/list]

notes.title: Trials of Fire Weekly Update #81 now Live
notes.content:
Trials of Fire v0.88 Release Notes

Happy Friday everyone.

This week’s update includes a big update to some of the in-game UI. We’re also looking at balancing out the Heroes’ class cards by tackling cards that are selected too or too much. While we’re not expecting parity on all card choices, this update tackles cards with a less than 10% pick rate or greater than 50%.

Let us know what you think of any of these changes on Discord!


[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated quest/party select pages.
[*] Updated camp pages to be more consistent.
[/list]

[b]Card Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] ‘Protector’ – Update effect to, ‘Whenever this character Defends itself, all other friendly Heroes within range 3 gain 2 Defence.’
[*] ‘Grit’ – Changed effect to ‘Defend 2 then remove all negative named effects.’
[*] ‘Defensive Movement’ (Warrior) – This card has been changed to ‘Shield Master’ with the effect, ‘Defending with an ACTION card, grants an additional +2 Defence.’
[*] ‘Goad’ (Warrior) – Reduced Willpower cost to 0 (from 1).
[*] ‘Line Up’ (Hunter) – Reduced damage bonus to +1 (from +2).
[*] ‘Sheltered’ (Hunter) – Damage bonus now applies to Magic Damage as well.
[*] ‘Rising Ire’ (Warlord) – Increased damage bonus to +3 and base cost to 3.
[*] ‘Tenacity’ (Warlord) – Changed effect to, ‘Gain +2 damage to all attacks for each different positive named effect this character.’
[*] ‘Lead by Example’ (Warlord) – Updated effect to ‘Defend 3 and grant Inspired to all other friendly characters.’
[*] ‘Thorn Blade’ (Witch) – Increased Melee Damage to 3 (from 2).

[list]

[list]
[*] Added new class card for the Elementalist and Witch to help with weaker play-styles.

notes.title: Trials of Fire Power Creep Update
notes.content:
Trials of Fire Power Creep Update (v0.60) Release Notes
(English version only).


Good afternoon all,

WE’RE BACK!

This update focusses on replayability by further differentiating the Hero Classes and giving the player more ways to tweak and customise their loadout as you progress through each adventure.

There are lot of changes to get through in this update, so buckle up.

As always, let us know what you think on Discord. On with the changes….

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]: Leaderboard Warning
[list]
[*] Once we’ve got in a bit of balance data on the changes from the community, we will be doing a reset on all leaderboards to reflect the updated mechanics.
[*] The plan is to do this in 2 weeks from today (on 31st July). Will post an update if anything changes.
[/list]

[b]Big Changes[/b]

Talents
[list]
[*] Each Hero now has a unique Talent which replaces the Soul Scarred talent from previous versions. A Talent is a once per turn ability that is triggered under certain conditions.
[*] Mouse over a Hero to view their Talent description and try to make the most of the Talents every turn!
[/list]

Power Cards
[list]
[*] Power cards can now be played on any Hero and not just the Hero that brings them into battle. Use this to your advantage to protect or buff specific Heroes and try out new combinations of abilities.
[/list]

Line of Sight and Movement
[list]
[*] Friendly characters no longer block movement or Line of Sight for ranged attacks. This gives a bit more room to manoeuvre and position without blocking off your other Heroes.
[*] You can also preview Line of Sight to any space by holding down Alt or the Right Mouse button on the arena.
[list]
[*] Yellow: Any character standing in this space can see.
[*] Green: Only friendly characters standing in this space can see. (Blocked by friendly.)
[*] Red: Only enemy characters standing in this space can see. (Blocked by enemy.)
[/list]
[/list]

Upgradable Cards
[list]
[*] Many cards in you deck can now be upgraded to make them even more effective.
[*] All item + class cards (Basic, Action, Power, Summon and Heroic) are upgradeable through a few new methods.
[/list]

Levelling Up
[list]
[*] When levelling up a Hero, you will now have the option to upgrade a card in your deck rather than swapping in an advanced card.
[*] Both Basic and Advanced cards can be upgraded so there are always options to improve your deck when levelling!
[*] Beware, though, you no longer gain any Health when levelling up.
[/list]

Camping Changes
[list]
[*] When camping, you can now use the crafting materials you find to upgrade your items – along with all their Skill Cards.
[*] In addition to healing injuries, Mystic Herbs can now be Meditate to either upgrade or remove a card from one of your Heroes’ decks. Find them in towns and forest areas to help refine your deck.
[*] Crafting items directly is no longer available.
[/list]

Content Updates
[list]
[*] 2 new item types have been added, Dagger & Robe, to further differentiate the classes a bit.
[*] Full review on in-game text to edit and abbreviate. Get into the action more quickly.
[list]
[*] All the lore is still there in hyperlinks/mission briefs for those who wish to dive in.
[/list]
[*] Endless Odyssey now presents a whole new challenge.
[list]
[*] Once you have run through all the standard boss tiers, you will start encountering multiple bosses at each objective!
[*] See how far you can progress.
[/list]
[*] Combat Run is currently disabled whilst I incorporate the new progress/camping mechanics.
[list]
[*] Should be back up and running in next week’s update.
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*] You can now Fast-Forward the enemy turn by holding down [Ctrl] when they are playing.
[*] All Side Quests now grant a Level Up upon completion in addition to any other reward.
[*] Updated Burning Effect to, ‘Suffer 2 Status Damage at the end of your turn or whenever you suffer Magic Damage,’ to make it more interactive.
[/list]

[list]
[*] If you’ve got this far then you are one of the hardcore so this is for you!
[*] Cataclysm 1: All enemies gain +15% health.
[*] Cataclysm 2: Enemy team gets +1 WP every turn.
[*] Cataclysm 3: 50% of Bosses' cards are upgraded.

[*] Cataclysm 9: All enemies gain an additional +20% health.

notes.content:
Trials of Fire Weekly Update (v0.49) Release Notes


Good afternoon all,

This week’s update features a major overhaul to how food works in game. No more starvation.

Food was never meant to be a particularly difficult part of the game, more a McGuffin to drive players both to explore (to find food) and to push the player towards their objective (before food runs out). While I think the system worked quite well, some parts of it were quite obfuscated, leaving players frustrated and overly punished by the mechanic.

The new system of Fatigue and Morale serves the same 2 purposes, but will hopefully be much more clear to players and rewarding to those taking advantage.

Please let us know what you think of these changes and anything else about the game on Discord!


Big Changes
[list]
[*] Fatigue and Food
[list]
[*] Food is no longer consumed by travelling around the map, only when camping, so no Starvation.
[*] No hidden scarcity of food, you will continue to be able to find food at the same rate throughout the adventure.
[*] Slightly increased Fatigue rate and reduced the penalties for ‘Drained’ and ‘Exhausted’ Fatigue levels.
[/list]
[*] Morale
[list]
[*] Morale is something new to be aware of.
[*] Morale will increase as the player approaches the goal of their quest but deteriorate if you take too long to reach the destination.
[*] High Morale will grant bonuses to Armour and Redraws in combat and increased healing rate and chance to find Epic items out of combat.
[*] Low morale will give penalties to Armour and Redraws and eventually lead to the party abandoning their quest altogether.
[*] This still serves as a soft-time limit on each leg of the journey, but it is no longer invisible to the player.
[/list]
[/list]

Trials of Fire Weekly Update (v0.47) Release Notes


Good afternoon all,

Again, I hope everyone reading this is keeping safe and not feeling too isolated from the world. Not a massive update this week because there has been a lot going on. Some pretty exciting stuff is on the way, but not quite ready for primetime.

So as a little taster of what is to come, this week we’ve added the ability to add your own custom portraits for your heroes in the game. Check out our Discord server for instructions and examples.

Big Changes

[list]

Good afternoon all,

This week’s update focusses on adding some more variable high-level strategies as well as making the game less frustrating for players focusing on Summoner builds or Power play.

As always, please post any thoughts or comments on our Discord. We always love to hear your feedback!

[list]

[*] Combat difficulty has been slightly re-balanced to compensate for this – most notably, all Bosses have had a health buff.
[/list]
[*] Summons Update
[list]
[*] Removed the increasing cost of additional Summons to make summon builds more viable across the board.
[*] Updated the opponent AI to deal with multiple player Summons more effectively.

But without the chance of this, this effect felt a bit too powerful for a zero-cost card.

[*] Slightly upped the difficulty of non-boss encounters (on Normal and above).

notes.content:
Early Access Heroic Update Patch Notes

Hi again,

This week’s build sees the introduction of a new class of Skill Card and lots of new powerful deck combinations. Heroic cards are powerful one-use actions that, if used correctly, can swing a battle in your favour.

Heroics have been as a further measure to make finding new items exciting and to help out larger deck builds without nerfing any leaner deck strategies that players have been mastering.

This update also sees some buffs to Warrior and Alchemist class cards.

As always, please let us know what you think of these changes on our Discord server!



Big Changes
[list]
[*] Heroic Cards are introduced in this build and can be found on many Epic and Legendary items.
[*] Heroic cards are designed to reward larger, item-based decks at the highest level and provide additional value some of the bigger cards in the game.
[*] Heroic cards are potentially more powerful than standard actions, but benefit from set up and particular decks built around them.
[*] These cards are single-use so can’t be used repeatedly, but are designed to have a potential huge single turn effect.
[*] Mechanically, Heroics work just like Action cards but with the following exceptions:
[list]
[*] When a Heroic card is played it is removed from the battle, so each can only be played once per battle.
[*] Whenever a Heroic card would be discarded, Recycled or Redrawn, it is shuffled into your deck instead. Heroic cards will always either be in hand or in your draw deck.
[*] Heroic cards cannot be duplicated by any game effect.
[/list]
[*] We’ve added new Heroic cards and updated several powerful, but under-used cards into heroics too.  See below for changes to existing cards.
[/list]


Heroic Card Changes
[list]
[*] ‘Channelling’ – Updated effect to ‘Gain 7 Willpower’.
[*] ‘Execute’ – Reduced cost to 4.
[*] ‘Multi Shot’ – Increased damage to 5.
[*] ‘Blizzard’ – Now inflicts an extra stack of ‘Chilled’ to enemies.
[*] ‘Sanctuary’ – Decreased cost to 1.
[*] ‘Immolate’ – Increased cost to 3, updated effect to, ‘Inflict Burning 3 on any enemy the deal 2 Magic Damage per Burning on the target.’
[*] ‘Sun Fire’ – Decreased cost to 5. Updated effect to ‘Magic Attack 8. If this defeats the target, deal 4 Magic Damage to all adjacent Characters. If any target is Burning remove all Defence before dealing damage.’
[*] ‘Surging Strike’ – Increased cost to 2, increased base damage to 3 and damage increase to +2 per card played.
[*] ‘Life Siphon’ – Reduced cost to 2, updated effect to, ‘Deal 3 unblockable Magic Damage to all enemy targets in the indicated area, draw a card for each target hit.’
[/list]


Card Changes
[list]
[*] ‘Metamorphosis’ – Updated effect to, ‘Replace each other card in your hand with a choice from 3 random cards costing 1 more Willpower, then reduce its cost by 2.’
[*] ‘Explosive Arrow’ – Increased base ranged damage to 3 (from 2).
[*] ‘Smart Infection’ – Increased damage and defence to 2-4 (from 1-4).
[*] ‘Measured Blow’ – Increased damage to 3 (from 2).
[*] ‘Single Out’ – Updated effect to, ‘Ranged Attack 2. The next card that is played on the target that would be discarded is returned to its owner's hand after use.’ This is to fix interactions with Heroic cards and cards like ‘Burrowing Barb’. 
[*] ‘Eldritch Grasp’ – Reduced base damage to 2 (from 3).
[/list]


UI
[list]
[*] Hovering over a character portrait on the end game summary and in the History page in the Statistics menu will show you the final composition of that hero’s combat deck.
[/list]


Significant Bugs
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when completing the 1st God Hunter objective.
[*] Effects that target randomly are now undoable if there is only 1 (or 0) available target.
[/list]

Hi again,

Not too many big updates this week. I’ve been working most of the week on localisation support and a few nasty Witch bugs. Big Changes
[list]

Card Changes
[list]
[*] ‘Overload’ – Updated effect to, ‘After you play a card that deals Magic Damage all future attacks deal +1 Damage. Lose +1 from the damage bonus each round.’
[list]
[*] This change is to slow down the infinite stacking of Overload, while allowing you to stack up just as quickly within a single turn.
[/list]
[*] ‘Evocation’ – Updated effect to, ‘All cards deal +1 Damage for every character they hit (up to a maximum of +3).’
[list]
[*] Again, this is to try to prevent this card from getting too out of control in large groups. While I generally dislike capping effects, I feel it works better here than slowing down the damage ramp up so you still get a nice benefit from hitting 2 or 3 targets.
[/list]
[*] •	‘Aura of Pain’ – Updated effect to, ‘All enemies within 3 spaces receive +1 damage from all attacks for each different named effect. Whenever damaged by a card from this character, they also get a random named effect.’
[list]
[*] This change is to primarily prevent the ridiculous stacking damage in conjunction with ‘Soul Blast’.
[/list]
[*] •	‘Static Discharge’ – Increased damage to 3.
[/list]

[*] We now have the 1st set of Chinese (Simplified) translations for cards in the game. This is very much WIP, but you update your language through Steam to see the changes.

Early Access Build v0.12 Patch Notes

IMPORTANT BALANCE CHANGES – PLEASE READ

Hi guys,

This week’s updates sees a number of big balance changes to make difficulty of each run a bit more consistent.

The main change is to the way Healing Herbs work now so you have a much better idea of the resources available to you on each leg of your journey. Also added a new option for your unwanted Skill Cards (Defence) for a bit more flexibility in your strategy as well as an option for experienced (and players just in it for the tactics/strategy) to view the outcomes of story choices if that is how you want to play.
More new features incoming next week.

Please get on Discord and let us know your thoughts on all these changes!


Big Changes
•	Any unspent cards that are still in the Recycle Shrine at the end of your turn are converted into Defence on a 1-1 basis. This was added to give you more options for your cards and give you a more reliable way to defend your Heroes.
•	Major balance changes to Healing Herbs. These changes are to make the difficulty of a quest less random and dependent on the number of Healing Herbs discovered as well as driving you on to the story goal.
o	Healing Herbs now heal more health (1/2 Maximum) and it only takes 1 herb to heal an injury.
o	You now receive more healing herbs at the start of the quest and can get a re-stock at each quest objective.
o	Healing herbs can be found in encounters but are very rare.
•	Rebalanced the ability damage curves for higher cost cards to increase the viable usage of higher cost cards (see card changes below).
•	Bed Down option has now been removed from camping. You will always gain health when resting in a sheltered location.
•	Added an option, ‘Story Choice Spoilers’ to the options menu. This option will show the potential outcomes to most story choices. Only use this option if you’re not interested in the story – just a mechanical playthrough – or if you’ve seen everything and want to help your memory without referring to notes/a wiki!

UI
•	Renamed ‘Combo Attack’ to ‘Combo Strike’ (since a Combo Strike is NOT an attack).
•	Added ‘Story Choice Spoilers’ option to the Options Menu

Balance Changes
•	See above
•	You can now play a Power if you already have 4 active, but you will need to choose one of the existing Powers to discard. (Don’t forget you can undo if you decide you were better off before).

•	‘Ricochet Shot’ – Increased damage to 3-5 from 2-4.
•	‘Head Shot’ – Decreased damage to 2 and cost to 2.
•	‘Fireball’ – Decreased cost to 4.
•	‘Eldritch Grasp’ – Increased damage to 3.
•	‘Frost Bolt’ – Decreased damage to 1 and cost to 1.
•	‘Wide Sweep’ – Increased damage to 5.
•	‘Sun Fire’ – Removed range restriction.
•	‘Rally’ – Increased cost to 2 and Willpower gain to 4.
•	‘Perfect Aim’ – Reduced cost to 1.

Significant Bugs
•	Fixed an issue not allowing you to use cards for a couple of seconds at the start of your turn sometimes, making the game feel unresponsive.

Content Updates
•	A handful of new items and cards added for this update.

Hello again. Thanks again to our community for their ongoing feedback. For May, we’ve been focusing on community gameplay, balance and usability feedback, so this patch includes some important changes to balance some of the slightly overpowered party builds.

Also some exciting behind the scene changes – including an overhaul to the combat AI and an optimisation to the CPU overuse issue that some in the community have been reporting.

Looking forward to hearing your feedback!

Features
•	Summon Changes: Summoned units now cost 1 extra Willpower for each Summoned unit you already 
•	Quick AI Mode: Pressing the Spacebar will toggle Quick AI mode on or off. •	Summons are proving a bit more effective than intended – particularly when used in groups of 2 or 3. This change will reign summon spamming back a little bit and we’ll monitor from here.
•	Tweaked the Act 2 boss to compensate for this nerf.
•	Overhauled the combat AI to improve the order enemies will play cards in, which will result in slightly harder battles.

Card Changes
•	Reduced the damage on Earth Grab to 2. The utility of this card (locking down a whole group of units) combined with the high damage was making it a bit too powerful.

Significant Bugs
•	Fixed a threading issue causing constant high CPU usage in battles.
•	The Redraw Card action can no longer be undone. (as intended)

The Action History is always there if you miss something. You can also change this in the options menu.
• Moved the Action History banner to a much more obvious position so it is visible in all arenas (Bottom right).

• Tweaked the Act 2 boss to compensate for this nerf.

notes.content:
Early Access Build v0.09 Patch Notes

Hello fellow survivors, the v0.09 continues to focus on feedback from our Steam and Discord community. It’s great to see so many players involved in the discussions, so if you’re not already, please sign up to Discord and get involved! In addition to the changes below we’ve been working on some stuff for a couple of big content updates in June. Look out for details soon!

Features
•	Redraws: Heroes now get a number of Redraws that they can use per combat (depending on Hero level). You can use a Redraw to discard your hand and redraw the same number of cards.
•	Leaderboards: Each quest now has its own Steam leaderboard, so you can compare your performance with your friends by either hovering over the ‘Rivals’ button in game or through the Steam community pages. By default, only your friends appear in the rivals list, but this can be changed in the options menu.
UI
•	Hovering over a Hero in battle will display his health as a breakdown of health and armour on the unit pop-up.
•	Food now displays to 1 decimal place, so you get a better idea of exactly how much you’re eating.
•	Added a ‘View Deck’ button to the Level Up page to view the contents of your Hero’s entire deck.

Balance Changes
•	Food distribution will now be more consistent over the course of the adventure. Food will ebb and flow, but the overall amount you find is much less random than previously.
•	Similarly, finding healing herbs will be more consistent.
Card Changes
•	Summoner: Reduced Resilience from 6 to 4.
•	Leadership: Reduced WP cost from 2 to 1.
•	Protector: Increased WP cost from 1 to 2.

Significant Bugs
•	You can no longer buy or pickup food or healing supplies if you are already at maximum, no more wasted food/obsidian
•	Dragging an item from a shop to your food supplies banner will no longer give you a free copy of that item! Sorry
•	You no longer have to move off and back onto a shop hex to re-open the shop UI, simply click on the hex or the coin-purse icon to bring up the shop.

Content Updates
•	Added visual effects for Earth based spells
•	4 new story events to uncover.
•	Unique Glasslands ruins obstacles

notes.title: Trials of Fire Patch v0.08 now Live
notes.content:
Early Access Build v0.08 Patch Notes

Welcome to the v0.08 update. We’ve got lots of cool changes some new stuff to talk about this week. A lot of the changes in this patch come from the great feedback we’ve already been receiving on Steam and Discord, so if you’re not already, please join us and get involved with the ongoing development of the game.

Features
•	Added the ability to undo your last action (if it did not result in an attack or a card draw). To do this, just click on the Recycle Shrine when there are no cards in it.
•	Updated Line of Sight calculations to be slightly more generous (careful, this works for enemies too!).
•	Adventure score and breakdown now displayed on finishing a quest, challenge your friends or try to beat your personal best! Steam leaderboards coming very soon
•	Added history to the statistics page to browse your previous attempts (this will only capture playthroughs completed since getting this patch I’m afraid).
•	Added a new endless quest (Endless Odyssey) that is unlocked by completing one of the basic quests – see how far you can get!

UI
•	Added Combo Attack preview UI – hover over an enemy with a Melee Attack action to see a preview of who will make a Combo Attack and which enemies are preventing it.

Balance Changes
•	We’ve tweaked the difficulty balance of the adventure more towards combat encounters rather than food consumption:
•	Increased the difficulty of battles in Normal mode (particularly in the 2nd half of the adventure).
•	Slightly increased difficulty of Act 2 & 3 bosses.
•	Fixed a bug preventing the AI from using certain Skill Cards (most notably Rally and Regroup)
o	This makes the Act 3 boss harder if you were reliant on Immobilise cards.
•	Increased food found by 5%.
•	Decreased the rate heroes lose health from Starvation by 50%.

Keyboard
•	Added keyboard shortcuts:
o	F1 – F3:		Open a hero’s inventory
o	Enter:		End Turn
o	Backspace:	Return all cards from Recycle Shrine

Card Changes
•	Updated some Skill Cards for balance and to provide some more obvious synergy with other cards.
•	Chop now deals an additional +1 damage for every named effect stack on the target.
•	Earth Grab now does additional damage, but grants Defence to the targets.
•	Clash now also does double damage if the target is Chilled.
•	Eldritch Grasp gains double and damage bonus on the character, reduced cost to 2, damage to 2.
•	Reduced the Resilience of Dead Eye to 2. 
•	Protector’s effect now only effects friendly targets near to the protector (Range 3).
•	Walk now gives a cost reduction of -2 Willpower instead of -1.
•	3 new Skill Cards to discover.

Legendaries
•	Iona’s Blade: The Reckless weakness card now inflicts a new status effect (Defenceless) so can be interacted with by other effects.

Art Updates
•	Updated artwork on Warlord class cards.
•	Added alternative glasslands ruins arena.
